description: codis-agents: refuses `git add -A` / `git add .`, pushes to protected branches or of protected tags without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1, and a commit, a reset or any other move of the arc branch (update-ref, branch -D / -f / -m, a push or fetch into it, worktree add -B; after a literal cd in the line too) while a live train holds the train lock that names it (wait for the train: train.js status). Active only in projects with .claude/codis-agents.json.
